definition: Why this one francesinha is retained as the restaurant reference item.
source_policy: Use documented choice: signature/house, otherwise traditional, otherwise standard.
example: Signature/house: official site presents Francesinha Rainha as iconic/flagship.

definition: URL supporting the reference-item selection.
source_policy: Use a public source that explicitly supports the selection.

definition: Keep one reference francesinha per restaurant; preserve other restaurant data unless directly affected.
source_policy: Do not invent ratings, prices, or ingredients; leave unverified fields blank.

definition: Preço da francesinha em euros.
source_policy: Guardar como número; aplicar formato €0.00; não incluir o símbolo € no valor.

definition: Indica se as batatas fritas estão incluídas na francesinha.
source_policy: Guardar como booleano TRUE/FALSE, não como texto.

definition: Indica se o ovo está incluído na francesinha.
source_policy: Guardar como booleano TRUE/FALSE, não como texto.

definition: Data da última atualização/recolha registada na folha.
source_policy: Usar o formato YYYY-MM-DD e atualizar quando os dados forem revistos.

definition: Indica se o restaurante oferece takeaway/recolha.
source_policy: Usar TRUE, FALSE ou UNKNOWN quando não houver confirmação.

definition: Indica se o restaurante oferece entrega ao domicílio.
source_policy: Usar TRUE, FALSE ou UNKNOWN quando não houver confirmação.

definition: URL que comprova os serviços takeaway/delivery.
source_policy: Preferir site oficial ou plataforma de encomenda; manter UNKNOWN quando a fonte não confirmar.

definition: Data em que os serviços foram verificados.
source_policy: Formato YYYY-MM-DD.

definition: Stable restaurant identifier used to join sheets.
source_policy: Use r### format; unique in Restaurants.

definition: Displayed restaurant name.
source_policy: Match the Restaurants name for the same restaurant_id.

definition: City or municipality recorded for the restaurant.
source_policy: Use the project’s location label; do not infer a different city.

definition: Street address used for location and geocoding.
source_policy: Keep the sourced address; do not invent missing components.
example: Praça de Dom João I, 175, 4000-425 Porto

definition: Whether a table reservation route is confirmed.
source_policy: Use TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN; phone alone is not proof.

definition: Google Maps rating for the restaurant.
source_policy: Use Google source only; store as a number with one decimal.

definition: Google Maps review count for the restaurant.
source_policy: Store as an integer; leave blank when not confirmed.

definition: Google Maps URL supporting the rating and review count.
source_policy: Use the restaurant’s Google Maps link.

definition: Date the Google rating and review count were collected.
source_policy: Store as a date in YYYY-MM-DD display format.

definition: Latitude in decimal degrees for mapping.
source_policy: Use decimal degrees; do not use DMS notation.

definition: Longitude in decimal degrees for mapping.
source_policy: Use decimal degrees; do not use DMS notation.

definition: URL supporting the reservation classification.
source_policy: Use the reservation or booking source; leave blank when not confirmed.

definition: Date reservation availability was checked.
source_policy: Store as a date in YYYY-MM-DD display format.

definition: Weekday represented by the opening-hours row.
source_policy: Use Monday through Sunday.

definition: Service interval represented by the row.
source_policy: Use Lunch, Dinner, Continuous or Closed.

definition: Opening time for the service interval.
source_policy: Store as a time in HH:mm; blank when closed.

definition: Closing time for the service interval.
source_policy: Store as a time in HH:mm; use 00:00 for midnight; blank when closed.

definition: Whether the restaurant is closed for the row’s day/service.
source_policy: Store as a boolean TRUE/FALSE.

definition: Public URL supporting the row’s value.
source_policy: Use a source URL; leave blank for an explicit no-documentation marker.

definition: Unique francesinha record identifier.
source_policy: Use f### format; unique in Francesinhas.

definition: Menu name of the francesinha.
source_policy: Use the sourced menu name.

definition: Category of the francesinha.
source_policy: Use Original, Vegetarian, Vegan or XXL.

definition: Bread type used in the francesinha.
source_policy: Use the documented bread type; leave blank if unverified.

definition: Documented sauce style or option.
source_policy: Use the project’s controlled labels; do not infer taste.

definition: Whether fries are fresh or frozen.
source_policy: Use Fresh or Frozen only when sourced.

definition: URL supporting the francesinha price.
source_policy: Use the menu or source page used for the price.

definition: Date the francesinha price was collected.
source_policy: Store as a date in YYYY-MM-DD display format.

definition: Category of an optional extra.
source_policy: Use Topping, Side, Protein, Sauce or None for no-documented-extras marker rows.

definition: Name of the optional extra.
source_policy: Use the menu name; use No documented extras found only for marker rows.

definition: Rating ajustado pelo volume de reviews, usado no ranking de restaurantes.
source_policy: Fórmula: (v/(v+500))*R + (500/(v+500))*C; R=rating, v=reviews, C=média geral Google.

definition: Rating Google ajustado por euro do preço médio da francesinha do restaurante.
source_policy: Usar apenas restaurantes com preço médio disponível; maior valor = melhor relação.

definition: Total de horas abertas por semana, somando intervalos não fechados.
source_policy: Calculado a partir de Opening Hours; 00:00 é tratado como meia-noite.

definition: Contagem de francesinhas Original, Vegetarian e Vegan por cidade.
source_policy: Cruzamento Francesinhas.restaurant_id -> Restaurants.city.

definition: Contagem e preço médio agrupados por fries_included.
source_policy: TRUE/FALSE da aba Francesinhas; preços preenchidos.

definition: Contagem de restaurantes com takeaway, delivery e reservas por cidade.
source_policy: Apenas TRUE; UNKNOWN não conta como FALSE.
